entity.summary: Hybrid cryptocurrency trading venue combining a centralized spot and derivatives exchange with a wallet-based decentralized perpetual-trading product that shares centralized liquidity.
entity.notes: Current first-party material describes a global exchange founded in 2021 and a wallet-based Zoomex DEX built on the CEX trading stack and shared liquidity. Independent current market data lists recently updated centralized spot markets, non-zero volume, reserves, and Seychelles registration. HEI consolidates the CEX, futures, and DEX surfaces into one hybrid entity. Confidence remains medium because the reviewed first-party pages do not clearly identify the current contracting legal entity. No unsupported exact launch date, predecessor, successor, terminal state, or incident event is asserted.
